content.text:
I built the landing page as a single file, `index.html`, in your project folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is untested.

All the text from `copy.md` is on the page, and the page uses every image in `images/`. It keeps the AEP Texas red and gray from the logo.

- **Header and hero:** The header has the logo, the navigation and a Log in button, and it stays at the top as you scroll. The hero uses the woman-on-the-phone photo with the "Knowledge is power." headline over its empty left side. The scam alert sits under the headline.
- **Quick links:** A red bar under the hero links to Electric Choice, Report an outage, Start/Stop/Move service, and Rates & Tariffs.
- **Savings and cards:** The energy savings section has the LED tip beside it. Below that are three cards for electric cars, business solutions, and new customers.
- **Outage alerts and features:** A gray band covers the outage alerts sign-up. Three image-and-text blocks follow for meter status, outage FAQs, and community.
- **Footer and login:** The footer has the phone number, the legal text and the social links. The "Welcome back!" login form opens as a pop-up when you click Log in. Its submit button doesn't send anywhere.
- **Small screens:** The navigation collapses into a menu button and the cards stack in one column.

The page links to the original aeptexas.com paths (for example `/outages/report`), so those links only work if the page is hosted on that site. The social icons are text links because `copy.md` had no icon images.

To preview it, open `index.html` in a browser.
